steps.description: Filter genes by mean log2 expression across samples, requiring the gene to be above a stated floor in at least 6 samples (the smaller group size), independent of group labels. plan.title: Muscle treated vs control DE (limma-trend) + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) normalized values, not counts, for 12 human muscle samples (6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch). This rules out count-based models (DESeq2/edgeR) and mandates limma-trend on the log-scale matrix, per the knowledge service's grounded procedure. The flow is: (1) sample-structure QC (PCA/MDS, sample distance, detected-gene counts) on the log2 values to surface outliers or batch-like structure before modeling; (2) filter low-abundance genes by mean log expression, requiring detection in at least 6 samples (the smaller group size), independent of group labels; (3) confirm the matrix is already normalized (log2(TPM+1), range check) and skip a second normalization; (4) fit a limma linear model with an explicit factor level (Control as reference) and contrast Treated-Control, using eBayes with trend=TRUE (log-scale/abundance data) and robust=TRUE (down-weight hypervariable genes); (5) select DE genes by BH-adjusted p-value, not raw p-value or fold-change alone; (6) run fgsea preranked GSEA on the moderated t-statistic (the disputed ranking-metric choice, stated explicitly) against MSigDB Hallmark (50 sets) and Reactome pathways as a second collection, both present in the reference store for human; (7) produce a report with full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene-set collection versions, design/contrasts/thresholds, n tested vs n DE, leading-edge genes, and the caveat that enrichment results are method-dependent). All steps validated against the Inflexa knowledge service (differential_expression and enrichment steps revised after an initial violation on the ranking-metric/method naming) with 0 violations remaining on the final check.
